similarSpecies.distinction: 紅胸秋沙鴨雄鳥胸部帶栗色及白斑、脅部灰色，沒有中華秋沙鴨雄鳥醒目的黑邊白色鱗紋；兩者均有細長紅喙及蓬冠。
普通秋沙鴨雄鳥白色脅部平滑、頭部深綠，沒有中華秋沙鴨的黑色魚鱗狀脅紋與更蓬鬆的長冠；兩者身形及長紅喙相近。

featureNotes: 細長紅色喙與明顯延長、蓬鬆的後冠
成年雄鳥頭頸呈黑綠光，白色前頸與胸部鮮明對比
白色脅羽具粗黑羽緣，形成魚鱗般重疊圖案，是物種重點特徵
黑色背翼配白色翼窗，與白身黑鱗脅部相連

rangeMap.note: Full-world partial overview only. The selected countries represent riverine breeding sites in the Russian Far East, northeast China and DPR Korea and the principal mainland-China wintering range described by the academic range survey. Green is not nationwide occupancy, not complete distribution and not a precise river-level or seasonal polygon. Hong Kong Checklist Category I is not used as a range polygon or local abundance rating.

sources.use: HKBWS Hong Kong Birds List 2024 read: Scaly-sided Merganser / 中華秋沙鴨 / Mergus squamatus appears as list no. 37, Category I, IUCN EN. Category I describes checklist status, not local commonness; no numerical Hong Kong abundance is inferred.

Cornell Lab eBird/Merlin species account read: sleek East Asian endemic with bright orange-red bill and long shaggy crest; male glossy green head and black-white back; female rusty-brown head and grey back; both sexes have prominent dark-edged white flank scales; breeds in forested montane river cavities and winters along rivers/lakes. Page displays BirdLife/IUCN 2025 status EN.

Peer-reviewed breeding-range survey: approximately 7,833 km of 120 suitable rivers across Russia, China and DPR Korea; breeding range concentrated in the Sikhote-Alin and Changbai mountain regions; telemetry and survey discussion describes wintering in mainland China, especially river systems. Used for cautious partial country map, not exact distribution polygons.

Full HKBWS Red-breasted Merganser account read: male has long narrow red bill, short sometimes spiky crest, dark green head, white collar, mottled chestnut breast with large white upper-flank spots; Hong Kong rare winter/passage visitor, global IUCN LC. Used as an explicitly labelled male comparison.

Cornell Lab Common Merganser identification account read: Eurasian male Goosander has a dark-green head, red bill, crisp white body and black back; females/immatures grey-bodied with rusty head and sharp white throat boundary. Used as a clearly labelled adult male comparison; the smooth white sides contrast with the scaly-sided species.
Reviewed exact adult male Red-breasted Merganser illustration reused as the correctly labelled male comparison, without recolouring or relabelling.
